result.description:
Two Daughters & Co. Pty Ltd 
T/A The Huddle Café

Unit 12, 102 -104 Lackey Street, Merrylands, NSW 2160

Full Time Retail Manager
$80,000 Plus Superannuation per year

Summary
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Retail Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of The Huddle Cafe a successful Takeaway cafe in Merrylands NSW 2160. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing staff, maintaining service standards, handling budgeting and financial reporting, coordinating stock and suppliers, and driving customer satisfaction and sales performance. This is a hands-on leadership role ideal for someone with a strong background in cafe or quick-service retail management who thrives in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Duties and Responsibilities
-	Manage the day-to-day operations of the café to ensure efficient service delivery and a high standard of customer experience.
-	Supervise, train and support café staff, allocate duties, monitor performance and foster a productive team environment.
-	Prepare and manage staff rosters to ensure adequate staffing levels during busy and quieter trading periods.
-	Monitor customer service standards, resolve customer enquiries and complaints promptly, and implement improvements to enhance customer satisfaction.
-	Oversee point-of-sale operations, cash handling, daily reconciliations and accurate recording of sales transactions.
-	Maintain stock levels of food, beverages and retail items by ordering supplies, monitoring inventory and minimising wastage.
-	Liaise with suppliers to ensure timely procurement of quality products and cost-effective purchasing arrangements.
-	Monitor sales performance, prepare operational reports and assist in achieving revenue, profitability and business growth targets.
-	Implement pricing strategies, promotional activities and local marketing initiatives to increase customer traffic and repeat business.
-	Ensure compliance with food safety, workplace health and safety, hygiene and relevant retail operating standards.
-	Monitor the presentation, cleanliness and merchandising of the café to maintain an attractive and welcoming environment.
-	Assist management in developing operational procedures and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Qualification and Experience
-	2-3 years of relevant experience in a retail, café, hospitality or food service management role is preferred.
-	Demonstrated experience supervising and leading staff in a fast-paced customer service environment.
-	Strong knowledge of rostering, stock control, budgeting and daily retail operations.
-	Experience using POS systems, inventory management software and Microsoft Office applications.
-	Excellent leadership, communication, organisational and problem-solving skills.
-	Ability to work under pressure while maintaining exceptional customer service standards.
-	Sound understanding of food safety, workplace health and safety, and retail compliance requirements.

Applications open on 24 July 2026 and close on 23 August 2026

Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

result.description:
Position: Retail Manager
Type: Full-time
Employer: Spice Indian Grocer Pty Ltd
Location: Wallan VIC 3756
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
Spice Indian Grocer Pty Ltd is a thriving Indian grocery store located in Wallan, Victoria, specialising in authentic Indian spices, groceries, fresh produce, snacks, kitchenware, and cultural essentials. As a dedicated supplier to the local Indian and South Asian community, the business is known for its extensive range of quality imported products, competitive pricing, and excellent customer service. Committed to cultural authenticity, freshness, and community connection, Spice Indian Grocer fosters a welcoming, family-oriented workplace culture where teamwork, attention to detail, and passion for delivering exceptional retail experiences are highly valued.
About the Position:
The Retail Manager will play a pivotal role in overseeing the day-to-day operations of Spice Indian Grocer Pty Ltd, ensuring efficient store management, optimal stock levels, and outstanding customer service. This position is critical for driving business performance, maintaining high service standards, and supporting the continued growth of the store within the local community.
Key Responsibilities:
Determining product mix, stock levels, and service standards to meet customer demand and business objectives.
Formulating and implementing purchasing and marketing policies, and setting retail prices.
Promoting and advertising the establishment’s goods and services to attract and retain customers.
Selling goods and services to customers and advising them on product use.
Maintaining records of stock levels and financial transactions.
Undertaking budgeting for the establishment, including monitoring revenue and expenses.
Controlling the selection, training, rostering, and supervision of staff to ensure a high-performing team.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Diploma in a relevant field (e.g., Retail Management, Business, or Hospitality).
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in a retail management role, preferably in a grocery or specialty retail environment.
Strong technical skills in inventory management, budgeting, financial record-keeping, and retail systems.
Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and supervise staff while delivering exceptional customer service.
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment with strong organisational and problem-solving capabilities.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
